# HealingMart typography requirement
Read AGENTS.md and [global font policy](https://github.com/healingmart/healingmart-cloudflare-guide-test/blob/policy/pretendard-20261028/FONT_POLICY.md). Pretendard Variable (self-hosted OFL) is standard; only verified Noto Sans extensions. No paid/unlicensed/proprietary OS fonts or CDN-only fonts; require font audit before build and deployment.
